title: Explicit orbit frames locally generate all tensor powers
statement: Let $H$ be a finite type, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $a:H\to\operatorname{Aut}(X)$ a family of automorphisms, and $q:X\to Y$ finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] with $a_h;q=q$ for every $h$. Let $L$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module]. For every $y\in Y$ there are an open $T\ni y$ and $s\in\Gamma(q^{-1}T,L)$ such that the explicit orbit section $n=\bigotimes_h a_h^*s$ is a free generator [def-sc-local-free-generator] of $N=\bigotimes_h a_h^*L$ on $q^{-1}T$, and $n^{\otimes d}$ is a free generator of $N^{\otimes d}$ there for every $d\geq0$. All sections and degree-zero conventions are those of [def-per-orbit-tensor-section-comparisons]. No group law on $H$ is required.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-finite-trivialize-invertible-upstairs] at y to obtain T and an isomorphism from the restriction of L over q inverse T to the structure module. Transport it through overEquiv and use exists_isFreeGenerator_of_iso to obtain s.

The Mathlib-pullback unit carries s to a free generator by the proved source lemma IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app. Compare ordinary and normalized tensor pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Its unit equation identifies the transported section with tensorPullbackSection. Restrict along the equality of invariant opens to obtain a free generator for each translated factor.

Use the proved source IsFreeGenerator.tmulSection and induct on the enumerating list to obtain the orbit frame. In the empty case, unitSectionsEquiv carries the section 1 to a free generator: coefficient multiplication is the unit sections equivalence itself. Induct on d with the same tensor lemma and unit case to obtain every pure power.

from.place: Expose XVI, section 3.7, printed pp.254--255: the scheme quotient X double-prime/H is projective over X. This lemma supplies descent of the orbit tensor of a line bundle through an already constructed finite quotient; it asserts neither existence of that quotient nor ampleness. Substep: Explicit orbit frames locally generate all tensor powers.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_orbit_tensor_local_frames {H : Type v} [Finite H] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : H → (X ≅ X)) (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite q]
    (aq : ∀ h : H, (a h).hom ≫ q = q) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (y : Y) :
    ∃ (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(L, q ⁻¹ᵁ T)), y ∈ T ∧
      IsFreeGenerator (orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
        (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s) ∧
      ∀ d : ℕ, IsFreeGenerator
        (orbitPowerSection (pencilOrbitBundle a L) (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) d
          (fun _ ↦ orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
            (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s))
